::: {#exm-simulation-mse-estimate}
#### A simulation estimate of the mean squared error from three replications

<!-- no-figure: the example is a hand calculation with three numbers -->

Continue the [three replications](#exm-simulation-estimate) with $\param = 5$.
The squared differences are $(3 - 5)\sq = 4$, $(5 - 5)\sq = 0$ and $(4 - 5)\sq = 1$,
so the [simulation estimate of the mean squared error](#def-simulation-mse-estimate) is

$$\frac{4 + 0 + 1}{3} = \frac{5}{3}.$$
:::
